scripts.check: vp check && fallow dead-code --format compact --fail-on-issues && fallow dead-code --production --format compact --fail-on-issues && fallow dupes --format compact --fail-on-issues && fallow health --complexity --format compact
scripts.fix: vp check --fix; status=$?; vp fmt && fallow dead-code --format compact --fail-on-issues && fallow dead-code --production --format compact --fail-on-issues && fallow dupes --format compact --fail-on-issues && fallow health --complexity --format compact && exit $status
